name: Dr Cindy Poppins - Computer Scientist (AKA Svea Eckert)
biography: Svea is a freelance journalist for Germany’s main public service broadcaster “Das Erste” (ARD). She is researching and reporting investigative issues with main focus on new technology, computer and network security, digital economics and data protection. Svea’s academic alter ego is Dr Cindy Poppins, a well-known computer scientist from the University of Applied Sciences of Lower Saxony at Wiepenkathen, Germany. Dr Poppin’s main focus lies on novel solutions for the analysis of agents. She recently discovered COP, an algorithm which improves compact technology and suffix trees, winning her the best presentation award at an international conference. @sveckert
